caption: Fig. 7. Agreement of three skeleton-derived descriptors for fixed skeleton loss. (a–c) Pale points show all 150 seed-specific pairs per descriptor; diamonds show 50 image means and vertical ranges span seeds. Dashed diagonals denote equality. caption: Fig. 8. Extractor sensitivity of retained-segment and candidate-junction descriptors. The grid covers 36 combinations of closing, pruning and minimum component size. Left panels show annotation-mask means and right panels show out-of-fold MAEs calculated against references at matching settings. Values are percentage changes from the retained default (closing 5 pixels, pruning 15 iterations, minimum size 10 pixels), which is outlined. Blue/red indicate decreases/increases and each panel has its own color scale; compare numerical ranges rather than color intensity across panels.
